nature_language: 我和朋友想从北京坐高铁去上海玩5天，预算3200元，不要坐飞机，住宿要位置好有免费停车，不吃火锅和川菜，偏爱小众秘境和历史古迹。
nature_language_en: My friend and I want to travel from Beijing to Shanghai by high-speed rail for 5 days with a budget of 3200 RMB, no flights, accommodation with good location and free parking, no hotpot or Sichuan cuisine, prefer hidden gems and historical sites.
